sheets.prompt: Interior of the traveller's small angular spaceship for a science fiction exploration game: a cosy walkable living space opening onto the cockpit, a curved console with a holo table and a voicemail screen, a narrow galley, a sleeping bunk in an alcove, storage lockers and hanging kit, round and angular windows looking out on a pale planet, warm lamp light and cool starlight, lived-in details. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, restrained cream paper grain, whimsical technology, clear readable construction, no lettering
sheets.why: I love the ship layout but the art style is not Moebius enough
